description: This file contains serialization and copying logic for the generic Queue<T> type in the Orleans framework, including a serializer class QueueCodec<T> and a copier class QueueCopier<T>.

classes.name: QueueCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for Queue<T> providing methods to write and read Queue objects to and from a wire format.

classes.name: QueueCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for Queue<T> objects, enabling cloning of queues within the Orleans serialization framework.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Queue<T> into a writer, including handling references and queue length.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a Queue<T> from a reader, reconstructing the queue and handling references.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a Queue<T> instance, utilizing a provided copier for elements.

methods.name: DeepCopy (overload)
methods.description: Copies elements from an input queue to an output queue, using a copier and context.
